# Vendored dependencies

## rapidhash.h

Verbatim copy of upstream, unmodified, so this repository has no external
source dependency and the hash matches the reference implementation exactly.

- Upstream: https://github.com/Nicoshev/rapidhash
- Version:  rapidhash V3
- Commit:   1ae7842f59f2 2026-08-19
- Retrieved: 2026-09-09
- Licence:  MIT (Copyright (C) 2025 Nicolas De Carli), retained in the header

This replaces a hand transcription that previously lived at
`prototype/rapidhash.h`. The transcription compiled and worked, but it was not
the reference algorithm, so calling it "rapidhash" was not strictly true and any
divergence would have gone unnoticed.

Do not edit this file. To update, re-fetch from upstream and record the new
commit here.
